api.runtime: FastAPI TestClient, disposable SQLite, synthetic metadata and conversations

initial_attempt.fixture_correction: Conversation creation requires exactly one user/assistant pair; message snapshots use their actual detail endpoints.

product_failures: Explicit null description returns 200 and retains the old description.
Explicit null color returns 200 and retains the old color.
Explicit null icon returns 200 and retains the old icon.
A project with a linked conversation also retains its cleared description.

synthetic_component_checks.runtime: Actual transpiled component callbacks and JSX, installed React static markup and TanStack MutationObserver/QueryObserver; explicit API and child doubles
confirmed_mechanisms: Description-only draft submits all four opening fields.
An unrelated name edit submits fallback color and icon for original null values.
A held follow-up callback keeps the confirmed form unclosed.
A rejected follow-up callback converts a confirmed write into mutation error.
Cached project variants do not receive the canonical save response.
A failed refresh retains a QueryObserver row but removes it from component markup.
Initial load failure exposes raw detail without the local Retry action.
The placeholder callback accepts another project's previous rows.
synthetic_component_checks.passing_guard: A 404 currently hides retained rows; preserve this boundary during repair.
